en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European town framed by tree branches, with rolling hills in the background. Dominating the skyline is a large Gothic cathedral with a very tall, delicate spire and a long nave; other church towers and historic buildings with steep roofs surround it. The photo has slightly scalloped edges typical of vintage postcards. No visible text appears on the image side.
